description.zh:
设备的可用空间，单位KB，取值为任意正数。
> **AvailableSpaceScope**字段必须同时传入才会生效。
description.en:
The free space of the device, in KB. The value can be any positive number.  
> The **AvailableSpaceScope** field must be specified together for this parameter to take effect.

description.zh:
设备可用空间的查询条件。

- **greater**：大于。
- **smaller**：小于。
- **equal**：等于。

示例：**AvailableSpace**设置为**500**，**AvailableSpaceScope**设置为**smaller**，则返回可用空间小于500KB的设备列表。
description.en:
The query condition for device free space.  

- **greater**: Greater than.  
- **smaller**: Smaller than.  
- **equal**: Equal to.  

Sample: If **AvailableSpace** is set to **500** and **AvailableSpaceScope** is set to **smaller**, the system returns a list of devices whose free space is smaller than 500 KB.

description.zh: 设备名称查询条件，最左前缀匹配。
description.en: The device name query condition, which supports leftmost prefix matching.

description.zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
description.en:
Instance ID.  

You must specify an instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  
><notice>  
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).  
></notice>
The current page number, starting from 1. Maximum value: 10000.

description.zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。
description.en: Project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

title.en: Query the list of announcement devices

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-speech-device --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --available-space 500 --available-space-scope smaller --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --device-name test --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QuerySpeechDevice --region cn-hangzhou --PageId 1 --AvailableSpaceScope smaller --AvailableSpace 500 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 20 --ProjectCode 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --DeviceName test
